```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 18)) #for ggplot

```

```{r}
lom <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "Lomatium_Demography_Data_CLEANED_2016thru2025.csv"))
climate <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "CGOP_climatevalues_scaled.csv"))
climate<- climate %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~lag(.x), .names = "prev_{.col}"))%>% 
  select(c(year, winter.mean.min.temp, prev_winter.mean.min.temp, summer.mean.max.temp, prev_summer.mean.max.temp, spring.mean.temp, prev_spring.mean.temp, fall.mean.temp, prev_fall.mean.temp, ends_with("tot.precip")))

#scott used size.t = log(No.leaves.t * Leaf.length.t) as the size measurement
lom <- left_join(lom, climate, by = c("Year" = "year"))
lom <- lom %>% 
  group_by(plantid) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year), 
         Plot = as.factor(Plot),
          psurvival = factor(psurvival, levels = c(0, 1)),
          psurvivalT1 = as.character(psurvivalT1),
         psurvivalT1 = factor(psurvivalT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pflower = factor(pflower, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pflowerT1 = factor(pflowerT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
    size = if_else(No.leaves > 0& Leaf.length>0, log(No.leaves* Leaf.length), NA),
         sizeT1 = lead(size),
    trt = as.factor(trt),
    trt = fct_relevel(trt, "irrigated", "control", "drought")) %>% 
  filter(Plot != "11")
```

```{r}
#get pop sizes year to year and lambda
lam <- lom %>%
  filter(Xcoor < 10) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%  # fix ordering
  group_by(Year, Plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(psurvival == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Plot, Year) %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = lead(n) / n
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
(lambda <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = lambda, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1)+
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(lambda)) +
  theme_minimal())
(n <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = n, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of plants") +
  theme_minimal())
(to <- lambda/n +plot_layout(guides = "collect")
)
ggsave(here("Figures", "lomatium", "groundtruth.lambda.png"), plot = to, width = 8, height =6)

```

```{r}
#size in current year or past year for flowering
lom_complete <- lom[complete.cases(lom[, c("pflower", "pflowerT1", "size", "Year", "Plot")]), ]
f.test1  <- glmer(pflower ~ size+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = lom_complete, family = "binomial")
f.test2  <- glmer(pflowerT1 ~ size+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = lom_complete, family = "binomial")
AIC(f.test1, f.test2) #one is better
```

```{r growth prequel}
base <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*Year + (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)
drop1(base,test="Chisq")
# base2 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+Year + (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)
# base3 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)
# a2 <- anova(base3, base2, test="LRT") #yes year is significant
best.growth <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size + (1|Year) + (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)

re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(best.growth)$Year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

# 
grow.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)
names(grow.corr)[names(grow.corr) == "(Intercept)"] <- "int"
###
vars <- names(grow.corr)[names(grow.corr) != "int"]

# Compute correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(grow.corr$int, grow.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into one data frame
cor_results_growth <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results_growth <- cor_results_growth[order(-abs(cor_results_growth$correlation)), ]
#summer.mean.min.temp
```

```{r pflower figure}
(flowering <- lom %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = size, y =  pflower))+

  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.1))+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept = 0, color= "grey", linewidth = .2)+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5))+
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5))+
```

```{r survival prequel}
# get correlations and p-values

  )
})
```
